open_points.subject: EXECUTION_STATUS_CONCLUSIONS for outcome_unknown
open_points.text: “the conclusion each NodeExecution status gives (A13 rules 5 and 7)” contradicts A13 rule 7 and A11 rule 3, under which the same `outcome_unknown` NodeExecution waits while its EffectAttempt is `unknown`, succeeds after resolution `applied` when the binding has no outputs, fails after resolution `applied` when it has outputs, and waits for approval after resolution `not_applied`.
open_points.question: How can a total table keyed only by NodeExecution status represent the context-dependent conclusion of `outcome_unknown`?
options: Give `outcome_unknown` a provisional table result and let `effects.operation_element_conclusion` override it from the EffectAttempt and binding
Key the correspondence by NodeExecution status plus EffectAttempt status and whether the binding has outputs
Exclude `outcome_unknown` from this correspondence, contrary to totality
open_points.default_guess: Use a provisional `waiting_outcome_unknown` result and let `effects.operation_element_conclusion` replace it after resolution.

open_points.subject: NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS taxonomy and table shape
open_points.text: “what each node conclusion means for the run and for its dependants (A13 rules 5 and 7) ... is a correspondence over that taxonomy ... a table here keyed by the enumeration, total over its members, whose cells name members.” No node-conclusion enumeration, run-effect enumeration, dependant-effect enumeration, row model, columns, or members are defined in `models` or in this state.
open_points.question: What exact model enumerations and total row shape does `NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS` use, including success, guard skip, failure, refusal and each wait state?
options: Add explicit NodeConclusion, RunEffect and DependantEffect enumerations and a row with separate run and dependant cells
Key the table directly by existing NodeExecutionStatus and use existing statuses as effects
Represent the effects as non-enumerated flags or code, contrary to the new correspondence rule
open_points.default_guess: Add explicit node-conclusion and effect enumerations, with separate cells for the run consequence and dependant consequence.

open_points.subject: HTTP_METHOD_BODIES cell type
open_points.text: “whether an HTTP method carries a body ... is a correspondence ... whose cells name members.” The required result is yes/no, but `models` defines only the HTTP-method enumeration and defines no enumeration whose members mean body or no body.
open_points.question: What model member type do the cells of `HTTP_METHOD_BODIES` name?
options: Define a body-presence enumeration with `body` and `no_body` members
Use booleans, relaxing the statement that cells name enumeration members
Use two sets of HTTP-method members instead of the stated table
open_points.default_guess: Define a `HttpBodyPresence` enumeration with `body` and `no_body`, mapping POST/PUT/PATCH to `body` and GET/DELETE to `no_body`.
